summary: The note taker asks committee counsel for help turning an unfamiliar discussion into a briefing the sponsor can use.
realLife: Dungan helped Vogelsinger assemble her notes for Kennedy after the rehearsal.
inGame: needs: staff briefing notes and counsel's review tied to the same bill version.

turns.what: Counsel checks the amendment references and sends the policy question to the sponsor.
turns.pulledBy: The notes leave the sponsor's intended position unclear.
turns.writesBack: The brief marks that answer for the sponsor.

turns.what: Counsel sends a correction after the briefing has gone upstairs.
turns.pulledBy: The clerk circulates a newer amendment text.
turns.writesBack: The office attaches a dated correction to the brief.
